card.name: Words inside titles and names
card.fires_on: A word or part of a word inside a proper name, title or fixed phrase, such as an organization, journal, book or product name, or the stock Healthwise line "To learn more". It sits where the next word is predictable.

modes.label: Stock Healthwise phrases
modes.description: Words in the closing Healthwise lines, such as "To learn more" and "health decisions".

modes.description: A linking or middle word inside an organization, journal or book title.
